open_leads.note: Event says (per BleepingComputer) a security update followed on 18 November and the action says apply it. startupfortune, relaying SecurityWeek/The Hacker News, says 0.8.5 and earlier are affected, a source fix was merged 19 October but no patched release exists and the advisory lists no update. Read the GHSA advisory (403 to WebFetch here) and the SecurityWeek and The Hacker News articles, then correct the action and summary if no release exists.
